conventions: Formatting uses Prettier (2-space indent, double quotes, trailing commas where valid, 80-char printWidth) and ESLint (--max-warnings=0).
TypeScript strict mode is enabled; use type-only imports (import type { ... }) after value imports, separated by blank lines between external, @excalidraw/* workspace, and relative imports.
Never mutate ExcalidrawElement instances directly in place; use newElementWith or scene.mutateElement so version and versionNonce bump for history and collaboration.
All user-facing UI strings must be looked up through t("labels.*") from packages/excalidraw/i18n.ts and defined in packages/excalidraw/locales/en.json.
Tests use Vitest and @testing-library/react with helpers from packages/excalidraw/tests/test-utils.ts, packages/excalidraw/tests/helpers/api.ts, and packages/excalidraw/tests/helpers/ui.ts.

decisions.topic: ExcalidrawTextElement styled ranges field name and empty representation
decisions.choice: Optional field textStyles?: readonly TextRangeStyle[] where TextRangeStyle = Readonly<{ start: number; end: number; color?: string; highlight?: string }>, omitted (undefined / key not set) when empty
rejected: Always setting textStyles: [] on every text element
Indexing ranges into wrapped element.text instead of element.originalText
decisions.reason: Omitting textStyles when empty keeps unstyled text elements byte-identical in memory and serialized JSON, preserving existing test snapshots and backward compatibility while indexing by UTF-16 code-unit offsets into originalText survives wrapping and resizing.

decisions.topic: Boundary behavior when typing at the end of a styled range
decisions.choice: Pure insertions at offset pos where range.start < pos <= range.end extend range.end by insertedLen; pure insertions at pos <= range.start shift both start and end right by insertedLen
rejected: Leaving range.end unchanged when typing at pos === range.end
decisions.reason: Extending on insertion at range.end matches standard rich-text editor behavior where continuing to type at the end of a coloured or highlighted word continues that style.

decisions.topic: Clearing range colour or highlight and resolving overlapping ranges
decisions.choice: Applying color === "transparent", null, or equal to element.strokeColor clears color on the selected span while preserving highlight; applying highlight === "transparent" or null clears highlight while preserving color; later ranges override earlier ranges per style attribute and adjacent identical ranges merge
rejected: Storing redundant color entries equal to element.strokeColor or "transparent" in textStyles
Clearing both color and highlight when only one attribute is reset
decisions.reason: Independent attribute clearing lets users remove highlight without losing text colour (or vice versa) and drops ranges that have neither attribute left.

decisions.topic: Per-line LTR vs bidi/RTL run positioning on Canvas and SVG
decisions.choice: Use isRTL(element.text) only for element base direction, and branch run horizontal positioning per visual line on hasRTLChars(line.text): pure-LTR lines (!hasRTLChars(line.text)) use left-prefix getLineWidth measurement, while lines with hasRTLChars(line.text) segment into directional bidi runs, order them visually via UAX#9 level reversal relative to base direction, and accumulate getLineWidth across visual runs
rejected: Branching run positioning on element-level isRTL(element.text) alone
Relying solely on DOM Range.getBoundingClientRect() which returns zero widths in jsdom/non-DOM environments
decisions.reason: An LTR-first line containing RTL tokens has isRTL(element.text) === false but hasRTLChars(line.text) === true; per-line hasRTLChars detection with UAX#9 visual-order width accumulation produces accurate run x/width on both browser canvas and SVG export as well as Vitest/jsdom.

decisions.topic: WYSIWYG live preview of styled ranges and selection preservation across properties panel clicks
decisions.choice: Render a synchronized mirror div (.excalidraw-wysiwyg-preview) behind the textarea with styled <span> runs while setting textarea color/-webkit-text-fill-color to transparent and caretColor to the dark-mode-filtered strokeColor when textStyles is non-empty, and cache the textarea selection range so clicking Stroke or Highlight pickers applies to the selected substring and restores the selection
rejected: Replacing the textarea with a contentEditable div
Only showing styled ranges after exiting the text editor
decisions.reason: Keeping the native textarea preserves all existing keyboard, IME, paste, list-marker, and test interactions while the synchronized mirror layer displays per-range colour and highlight live during editing.

decisions.topic: Highlight colour picker popup id isolation and sticky-note ink sync
decisions.choice: Add "textHighlight" to AppState["openPopup"] in types.ts, map openPopup: "elementBackground" from ColorPicker's updateData to "textHighlight" in actionChangeTextHighlight.perform, and in actionChangeTextHighlight.PanelComponent pass ColorPicker an appState view that maps "textHighlight" <-> "elementBackground" (and maps a real "elementBackground" to "canvasBackground" so ColorPicker sees openPopup !== type), while in actionChangeStrokeColor bypassing element.strokeColor, currentItemStrokeColor, and syncStickyNoteInk when editingTextElement has a non-empty selection (start < end)
rejected: Sharing appState.openPopup === "elementBackground" between actionChangeBackgroundColor and actionChangeTextHighlight
Withholding actionChangeBackgroundColor while editing a sticky-note label (which breaks sticky-note background editing during label edit)
Using component-local useState for popup state without updating appState.openPopup
decisions.reason: ColorPicker.tsx (not on the allowlist) opens when appState.openPopup === type and accepts only ColorPickerType values; storing "textHighlight" in AppState["openPopup"] and translating at actionChangeTextHighlight's boundary lets both the sticky-note background picker and the text highlight picker render simultaneously with distinct popup ids so opening one never opens the other.
